caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile with a series of horizontal, wavy and straight-edged stripes in various colors. The stripes alternate in color and thickness, and include shades of red, pink, coral, blue, green, yellow, brown, grey, and beige. The composition features a repeating pattern of shorter vertical dashes within some of the broader horizontal stripes, creating a decorative effect. The colors are arranged in distinct bands, with several warm tones concentrated in the upper portion and more muted earth tones toward the lower part. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorations surrounding the central textile drawing. A small signature appears to the lower right of the textile, just above the lower edge of the rectangle.
title: Striped Stair Carpet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
